Преобразование Бокса–Мюллера: нормальные (гауссовы) случайные числа function randomGaussian(mean = 0, stdev = 1) { const u1 = Math.max(1e-7, 1 - Math.random()); const u2 = Math.random(); const z0 = Math.sqrt(-2.0 * Math.log(u1)) * Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * u2); return z0 * stdev + mean; } // 2. Инициализация ансамбля Максвелла–Больцмана по температуре T function createThermalGasEnsemble(N, T, kB, mass, width, height, topY) { const particles = []; const sigma = Math.sqrt((kB * T) / mass) * 22; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { particles.push({ x: 15 + Math.random() * (width - 30), y: topY + 15 + Math.random() * (height - topY - 30), vx: randomGaussian(0, sigma), vy: randomGaussian(0, sigma), radius: 3.5, mass: mass }); } return particles; } // 3. Импульсы упругих столкновений со стенками и поршнем function updateGasWallCollisions(particle, left, right, top, bottom, dt) { let impulse = 0; particle.x += particle.vx * dt * 60; particle.y += particle.vy * dt * 60; if (particle.x - particle.radius < left) { particle.x = left + particle.radius; particle.vx = -particle.vx; impulse += 2 * particle.mass * Math.abs(particle.vx); } if (particle.x + particle.radius > right) { particle.x = right - particle.radius; particle.vx = -particle.vx; impulse += 2 * particle.mass * Math.abs(particle.vx); } if (particle.y - particle.radius < top) { particle.y = top + particle.radius; particle.vy = -particle.vy; impulse += 2 * particle.mass * Math.abs(particle.vy); } if (particle.y + particle.radius > bottom) { particle.y = bottom - particle.radius; particle.vy = -particle.vy; impulse += 2 * particle.mass * Math.abs(particle.vy); } return impulse; }

Initialise a Maxwell–Boltzmann ensemble at temperature T function createThermalGasEnsemble(N, T, kB, mass, width, height, topY) { const particles = []; const sigma = Math.sqrt((kB * T) / mass) * 22; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { particles.push({ x: 15 + Math.random() * (width - 30), y: topY + 15 + Math.random() * (height - topY - 30), vx: randomGaussian(0, sigma), vy: randomGaussian(0, sigma), radius: 3.5, mass: mass }); } return particles; } // 3. Elastic collision impulses with the walls and the piston function updateGasWallCollisions(particle, left, right, top, bottom, dt) { let impulse = 0; particle.x += particle.vx * dt * 60; particle.y += particle.vy * dt * 60; if (particle.x - particle.radius < left) { particle.x = left + particle.radius; particle.vx = -particle.vx; impulse += 2 * particle.mass * Math.abs(particle.vx); } if (particle.x + particle.radius > right) { particle.x = right - particle.radius; particle.vx = -particle.vx; impulse += 2 * particle.mass * Math.abs(particle.vx); } if (particle.y - particle.radius < top) { particle.y = top + particle.radius; particle.vy = -particle.vy; impulse += 2 * particle.mass * Math.abs(particle.vy); } if (particle.y + particle.radius > bottom) { particle.y = bottom - particle.radius; particle.vy = -particle.vy; impulse += 2 * particle.mass * Math.abs(particle.vy); } return impulse; }
